newsitem.title: USA: Ames to take $8 mln 4th qtr charge.
newsitem.headline: Ames to take $8 mln 4th qtr charge.

text.p: Ames Department Stores Inc said Thursday it will take a charge of about $8 million in the fourth quarter to close 12 stores in 1997.
The company did not say by how much its earnings per share would be affected by the charge. Ames officials were not immediately available to comment.
Ames, which expects to complete the closings by the end of February, said nine of the stores' lease terms expire in 1997.
Following the closings, Ames will have 291 stores. It plans to open four stores on April 10 and between five and 10 in 1997, it added.
